raw_reason: Lack of IRB/IACUC Approval and/or Compliance
canonical_reason: Lack of IRB/IACUC Approval and/or Compliance
definition_used: Failure to obtain consent from the institutional ethical review board overseeing human or animal experimentation prior to initiation of study, or failure to provide proof of such
semantic_rationale: The definition describes failure to obtain or prove ethical review board approval, which directly concerns research ethics approval process and ethics/welfare of subjects. This impacts both the integrity of authorship disclosures (missing required approvals) and the reliability of research content (non-compliance with ethical standards).
